Technical Requirement & Specification: Type Approval per Chemistry: Each lithium-ion battery type (LFP) must hold valid type approval covering drawing approval works assessment and type testing.
Evidence Document: Clean Electric LFP Type Test Dossier

Technical Requirement & Specification: Vessel Unit Certification: Specific battery units fitted to vessel undergo surveyor-witnessed FAT and unit testing prior to installation.
Chemistry Declaration: State active cathode/anode chemistry unambiguously (LiFePO4 / LFP) with cell/module part numbers.
Cell Marking (IEC 62620): Cells marked with secondary Li-ion designation polarity date of mfg manufacturer ID rated Ah nominal VDC caution note.
Evidence Document: Cell Surface Laser Marking Inspection Record

Technical Requirement & Specification: Change Control & Validity: Type approval validity 5 years. Any change in cell active material casing or chemistry invalidates approval.
Capacity Adequacy: Installed capacity sufficient for vessel duty. Provide cell/module ratings usable kWh and derating assumptions.
Propulsion Redundancy Exemption: AMBESS is dedicated to auxiliary/hotel anchor loads. Main propulsion redundancy rules do not apply.
Cell Safety Testing (IEC 62619): Cell drop external short circuit impact overcharge thermal abuse testing.
Thermal Runaway Non-Propagation: Test demonstrating runaway in a single cell does not propagate to adjacent cells or is contained in module.
Evidence Document: Immersion Runaway Bench Test Report (818 Cycles)

Technical Requirement & Specification: UL 9540A Test Equivalence: Characterization of off-gas composition (H2 CO) LFL heat release rate (HRR) and re-ignition hazards.
Enclosure Surface Temperature: Enclosure exterior must remain below critical ignition limit (<100°C) during internal runaway.
Evidence Document: Aluminum Casing Thermal Finite Element Analysis (FEA)

Technical Requirement & Specification: Off-Gas Pressure Relief: Casing fitted with pressure relief valve discharging gas safely to exterior without casing rupture.
Immersion Cooling Arrangement: Details of closed-loop dielectric immersion cooling pump P1 circulation and casing heat dissipation.
Evidence Document: Immersion Cooling Technical Submission Rev A

Technical Requirement & Specification: Shop Fabrication Hydrotest: Cooling tank tested to 1.5 x Design Pressure for 30 minutes with zero leakage.
Shipboard Tightness Test: Cooling system tested to 1.0 x Design Pressure following onboard shipyard installation.
Evidence Document: Shipboard Installation & Pre-fill Leak Check SOP

Technical Requirement & Specification: Protection of Live Parts: No mechanical pipe joints located directly over live electrical terminals. Monolithic sealed casing.
Evidence Document: Mechanical Tank GA & Flange Detail Drawings

Technical Requirement & Specification: Cooling Failure Alarm: Failure of pump P1 loss of circulation or excessive Delta T must trigger an alarm at manned control station.
Evidence Document: BMS Pump Current & Delta T Alarm Logic Specification

Technical Requirement & Specification: Dielectric Coolant Specification: Fluid breakdown >50 kV flash point >160°C non-toxic readily biodegradable.
Evidence Document: Coolant Technical Data Sheet & OECD 301B Test

Technical Requirement & Specification: Single-Cell Voltage & Temp: Voltage of every cell tab and representative temperatures monitored continuously.
Critical Override Prohibition: No manual override or software bypass permitted for over-V under-V over-T or short-circuit trips.
Dual Independent Disconnect: Two independent isolation devices (positive & negative DC contactors + pyro-fuses).
Loss of Communication Safe State: Communication timeout (>250 ms) between Master BMS and CSCs reverts system to safe trip.
Insulation Resistance (IMD): Continuous monitoring of ungrounded DC bus. Warning at 100 Ohm/V; trip at 50 Ohm/V.
SOC & SOH Estimation: Deterministic algorithm for SOC/SOH tracking with cycle-drift compensation.
Evidence Document: SOH Estimation Algorithm Whitepaper (818 Cycle Data)

Technical Requirement & Specification: IACS UR E10 Environmental Tests: Dry heat damp heat cold power variation tests on BMS hardware.
Evidence Document: Schedule UR E10 test suite at NABL/ILAC lab

Technical Requirement & Specification: Sinusoidal Vibration: 2-13.2 Hz (+/-1.0 mm); 13.2-100 Hz (0.7g) on 3 orthogonal axes for module and casing.
Evidence Document: Multi-Axis Vibration Test at Accredited Test Facility

Technical Requirement & Specification: Inclination Testing: Static 22.5° and dynamic 22.5° roll/pitch to verify pump P1 immersion & circulation.
EMC Immunity & Emissions: Radiated/conducted emissions burst surge and ESD per UR E10.
Evidence Document: EMC Test Report from Accredited Lab

Technical Requirement & Specification: Enclosure Ingress Protection (IP67): Certified dust-tight and immersion-proof casing test per IEC 60529.
A-60 Boundary & Category A Space: Battery compartment treated as Category A machinery space with A-60 structural insulation.
Compartment Ventilation: Minimum 2 ACH continuous normal; minimum 6 ACH emergency exhaust on gas detection.
Hazardous Area Classification: Battery space classified Zone 2; all electrical fittings certified at least Ex IIC T1.
Evidence Document: Hazardous Area Classification Drawing & Ex List

Technical Requirement & Specification: Gas Detection & Interlocks: Flammable gas alarm & 6 ACH vent at 30% LFL; total non-Ex de-energization at 60% LFL.
Evidence Document: Fire & Gas Panel Logic & Trip Matrix

Technical Requirement & Specification: Fixed Water-Based Extinguishing: Space protected by fixed water mist/sprinkler approved for Category A spaces.
Remote Emergency Shutdown (ESD): ESD operable from wheelhouse CCR and outside the battery room.
Evidence Document: ESD Single Line Diagram & Tripping Schedule

Technical Requirement & Specification: O&M Manual Firefighting Risks: Manual covers post-fire risks: stored energy in cells re-ignition CO toxic off-gas PPE.
